title: AnimationStateMachine `advance_on_start` option doesn't work correctly except transition on the first time
body: ### Tested versions Vulkan 1.4.312 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 ### System information Vulkan 1.4.312 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 ### Issue description I'm using a free personal-use character asset available on Itch, which includes turn transition animations similar to those in Castlevania: Symphony of the Night. While learning to implement these transition animations, I noticed a subtle 16ms startup delay during state switching in the AnimationTree's state machine. This delay causes a twitch when the character flips (flip) and the turn animation plays. ### Steps to reproduce I confirmed that this twitch does not occur when directly playing animations via AnimationPlayer and using await to sequence them. The issue is exclusive to transitions handled by the AnimationTree's state machine. Further testing revealed that the AnimationTree state machine has a 16ms delay before entering a new state and starting the animation. This delay results in one frame where the character's facing direction is reversed—because the turn animation hasn’t started playing yet when the flip occurs. ```gdscript extends CharacterBody2D @onready var animation_player: AnimationPlayer = $male_hero_free/AnimationPlayer const SPEED = 300.0 const JUMP_VELOCITY = -400.0 @onready var animation_tree: AnimationTree = $AnimationTree var direction: float = 0.0 var facing: int: get(): return sign(transform.x.x) var acceleration: float = 400.0 var deceleration: float = 400.0 var walk_min_speed: float = 10.0 var last_tick = 0 func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void: var sm = animation_tree["parameters/locomotion/playback"] as AnimationNodeStateMachinePlayback if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_up"): animation_tree.active = true last_tick = Time.get_ticks_msec() printt("flip") print_timestamp() flip_h() print("after_flip") print_timestamp() print("begin_play_idle_turn") sm.travel("idle_turn") if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_down"): animation_tree.active = false last_tick = Time.get_ticks_msec() printt("flip") print_timestamp() flip_h() print("after_flip") print_timestamp() print("begin_play_idle_turn") animation_player.play("idle_turn") await animation_player.animation_finished animation_player.play("idle") move_and_slide() func print_timestamp(): var cur_tick = Time.get_ticks_msec() printt(Time.get_ticks_msec(), "gap", cur_tick - last_tick) last_tick = Time.get_ticks_msec() func flip_h(): transform *= Transform2D.FLIP_X ``` ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7b838669-4564-4fe5-bd54-d4e25626529a) ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9278fb27-e0e8-41e8-a3ac-19aff082271c) ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5fe48623-3fb9-40ac-ba11-da885aa3d211) ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ad627e00-c73f-4b77-8c45-7e0a37dcd15a) ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a2cd2393-d424-45fb-92be-7681d83e161c) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23193202/mrp.zip)
